corrections.text: The article attributes four specific release dates (v37.0.0 on October 7, 2026; v37.0.1 on October 9, 2026; v37.0.2 on November 6, 2026; and v36.0.1 'already present by' May 20, 2026) to the project's CHANGELOG.md. The CHANGELOG.md file contains no dates anywhere; it lists only version numbers and Kubernetes API versions. The dates themselves are correct and are drawn from the project's GitHub Releases page (api.github.com/repos/kubernetes-client/python/releases), which was not among the article's cited sources.
